An Act to deal with consequential matters arising from the enactment of the Climate Change Act 2022, and for other purposes

content.p: This Act is the Climate Change (Consequential Amendments) Act 2022.

Each provision of this Act specified in column 1 of the table commences, or is taken to have commenced, in accordance with column 2 of the table. Any other statement in column 2 has effect according to its terms.

tr.td: The later of: (a) the start of the day after this Act receives the Royal Assent; and (b) the commencement of the Climate Change Act 2022. However, the provisions do not commence at all if the event mentioned in paragraph (b) does not occur.

content.p: Note: This table relates only to the provisions of this Act as originally enacted. It will not be amended to deal with any later amendments of this Act.
Any information in column 3 of the table is not part of this Act. Information may be inserted in this column, or information in it may be edited, in any published version of this Act.

Legislation that is specified in a Schedule to this Act is amended or repealed as set out in the applicable items in the Schedule concerned, and any other item in a Schedule to this Act has effect according to its terms.

Repeal the section, substitute:
ARENA may perform its functions only in accordance with this section.
Main constitutional basis
ARENA may perform its functions with respect to external affairs, including:

to give effect to the Climate Change Convention and the Paris Agreement, including by supporting activities and projects that could reasonably be expected to control, reduce or prevent anthropogenic emissions of greenhouse gases; and
to give effect to another international agreement to which Australia is a party; and
by way of performing its functions in a place outside Australia.
Other constitutional bases
In addition, ARENA may perform its functions:
with respect to providing financial assistance for:
research into renewable energy technologies undertaken by constitutional corporations; or
the development, demonstration, commercialisation or deployment of renewable energy technologies by constitutional corporations; or
with respect to trade or commerce:
between Australia and places outside Australia; or
among the States; or
within a Territory, between a State and a Territory or between 2 Territories; or
with respect to statistics; or
with respect to a postal, telegraphic, telephonic or other like service; or
with respect to the provision of a service, or financial assistance, to:
the Commonwealth; or
an authority of the Commonwealth;
for a purpose of the Commonwealth; or
with respect to a grant of financial assistance to a State; or
with respect to, or in, a Territory; or
with respect to activities that are peculiarly adapted to the government of a nation and cannot otherwise be carried on for the benefit of the nation; or
with respect to the executive power of the Commonwealth; or
with respect to matters incidental to the execution of any of the legislative powers of the Parliament or the executive power of the Commonwealth.
Meaning of terms
A term used in this section and the Constitution has the same meaning in this section as it has in the Constitution.

between Australia and places outside Australia; or

Supplies of products
This Act applies to the following supplies of a product:
supply of the product, being a supply whose regulation is reasonably appropriate and adapted to give effect to Australia’s obligations under:
the Climate Change Convention; or
the Paris Agreement; or
another agreement between Australia and one or more other countries;
supply of the product by or to a constitutional corporation;
supply of the product in the course of constitutional trade or commerce;
supply of the product using a postal, telegraphic, telephonic, or other like service (within the meaning of paragraph 51(v) of the Constitution);
supply of the product by or to the Commonwealth or a Territory, or by or to an authority or instrumentality of the Commonwealth or a Territory;
supply of the product occurring in a Commonwealth place or a Territory.
Note: The expression this Act has an extended meaning (see the Dictionary in section 5).
Offers to supply products
This Act applies to the following offers to supply a product:
an offer to supply the product, being an offer whose regulation is reasonably appropriate and adapted to give effect to Australia’s obligations under:
the Climate Change Convention; or
the Paris Agreement; or
another agreement between Australia and one or more other countries;
an offer to supply the product made by or to a constitutional corporation;
an offer to supply the product made in the course of constitutional trade or commerce;
an offer to supply the product made using a postal, telegraphic, telephonic, or other like service (within the meaning of paragraph 51(v) of the Constitution);
an offer to supply the product made by or to the Commonwealth or a Territory, or by or to an authority or instrumentality of the Commonwealth or a Territory;
an offer to supply the product occurring in a Commonwealth place or a Territory.

use of the product for a commercial purpose, being a use whose regulation is reasonably appropriate and adapted to give effect to Australia’s obligations under:

use of the product for a commercial purpose by the Commonwealth or a Territory, or by an authority or instrumentality of the Commonwealth or a Territory;
